# GamepadButton

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Input` · enum

```csharp
public enum GamepadButton
```

A gamepad's buttons, by where they are rather than what's printed on them: [`South`](#south) is A on an Xbox pad, B on a Nintendo one and the cross on a PlayStation one.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="south"></a>`South` | The bottom face button: A on Xbox, Cross on PlayStation. |
| <a name="east"></a>`East` | The right face button: B on Xbox, Circle on PlayStation. |
| <a name="west"></a>`West` | The left face button: X on Xbox, Square on PlayStation. |
| <a name="north"></a>`North` | The top face button: Y on Xbox, Triangle on PlayStation. |
| <a name="leftshoulder"></a>`LeftShoulder` | The left bumper. |
| <a name="rightshoulder"></a>`RightShoulder` | The right bumper. |
| <a name="back"></a>`Back` | The back or select button. |
| <a name="start"></a>`Start` | The start or menu button. |
| <a name="guide"></a>`Guide` | The guide or home button. |
| <a name="leftstick"></a>`LeftStick` | Pressing the left stick. |
| <a name="rightstick"></a>`RightStick` | Pressing the right stick. |
| <a name="dpadup"></a>`DPadUp` | Up on the directional pad. |
| <a name="dpaddown"></a>`DPadDown` | Down on the directional pad. |
| <a name="dpadleft"></a>`DPadLeft` | Left on the directional pad. |
| <a name="dpadright"></a>`DPadRight` | Right on the directional pad. |
